title: Knotted Crepe Cap Sleeve Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
This dress combines timeless elegance with a flattering silhouette. The embroidered sheer bodice adds subtle detail, while the knotted waist and soft ruching help define the waistline and smooth the midsection. Finished with cap sleeves and a graceful front slit, it's a polished option for wedding celebrations, formal receptions, and evening events.


Size Tip: The waist and hip areas have high stretch, but the bust area has no stretch. If your measurements vary between sizes, prioritize your bust measurement when choosing your size.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor-length.


Sleeve Style: Cap Sleeve.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises crepe.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
